scope: Final GL00 and GL01 physical three-route acceptance. GL262 explicitly deferred by the user; no GL262 performance acceptance is claimed.

protocol.duration_measure: sum(batch.total * batch_sample_count), excluding warmup and priming

timing_boundary_definitions.total_time: Native graph generation timer; excludes CLI startup and state serialization. Includes Spenso preprocessing and Symbolica evaluator construction.
timing_boundary_definitions.expression_build_time: Native total_time minus evaluator_spenso_time, evaluator_symbolica_time, and evaluator_compile_time. Broader expression/UV construction and setup; not an isolated UV-only timer.
timing_boundary_definitions.evaluator_spenso_time: EvaluatorStack preprocessing: tensor parsing/contraction, scalar alias resolution and scalar combination.
timing_boundary_definitions.evaluator_symbolica_time: Evaluator variant preparation/build and optimization after tensor preprocessing.
timing_boundary_definitions.total_minus_symbolica_time: Native total_time minus evaluator_symbolica_time; retains tensor preprocessing. This boundary is not faster for direct 4D in these runs.
timing_boundary_definitions.evaluator_compile_time: Zero for every final run; generated evaluator code compilation disabled.
timing_boundary_definitions.process_wall_seconds: Supervisor child wall time, including CLI startup/serialization; 1-second polling granularity; not the generation acceptance metric.

uncertainty_scope: Observed spreads and pass-mean ±2 within-pass SEM envelopes are descriptive repeat triggers, not statistical confidence intervals.
dispatch_scope: Dispatch profiling is a separate validation stage. Its profiled generation times never enter final unprofiled generation/runtime statistics; historical child-only percentages do not certify current complete dispatch overhead.
